changelog.note: Removed the optional Juicebox-sample step — a Juicebox demo was enough; report sampling not needed. Relabeled the Phase 0 — Deliverables badge from 'End of Engagement' to 'End of Phase 0'.
Marked the Juicebox-sample and Common Client ID coverage steps optional (DAS-dependent) — they are now tracked as optional open questions, not committed Conflict work.

Refresh discovery steps: access-provisioning closed (DWRPT granted, EDW/Juicebox not provisioned per the replace-don't-reinvest call); added the 2026-06-12 exec sync and 2026-06-13 architecture design pass.
Timeline made data-driven; every step references its output or a placeholder

steps.title: Kickoff — Conflict & DAS team introductions
steps.desc: Established project scope, team roles, CDP objectives. Attendees: Daniel Aston, Alex English, Mike Paylor, full Conflict team.

steps.title: SSIS Infrastructure Deep Dive
steps.desc: Reviewed 13 SSIS jobs, monitoring dashboard, failure modes, and AWS EC2/RDS infrastructure with Rick Sorich and engineering team.

steps.title: Reporting & Juicebox Review
steps.desc: Reviewed Juicebox platform, DWRPT view inventory, Common Client ID implementation, and live DAS AI agent demo.

steps.title: System access — resolved
steps.desc: Access requests closed 2026-06-12. DWRPT granted (self-serve Common Client ID audit + reporting-parity reference); EDW_Staging and Juicebox not provisioned, per the don't-over-invest-in-replaced-systems call. Two people-asks survive: Ron (Common Client ID logic), Rick (SSIS job descriptions).

steps.title: Exec sync — Dan Aston + Mike Paylor
steps.desc: CDP confirmed as the source of truth; SSIS/EDW retire; event intake co-primary with batch. Mike's #1: golden record from real data + field prioritization. Identity-resolution strategy options commissioned (Alicia + Luis, due 2026-06-19).

steps.title: Architecture design pass — CDP target stack
steps.desc: Recommended the Phase 0 target architecture: AWS, native RDS Postgres + RLS, NATS, Airflow=ingest / Temporal=app, Event Grid Option A, bitemporal provenance, portability. Reconciled the wiki; drafted the Revised Architecture Plan; routed six identity/data-model directions to Alicia + Luis (due 2026-06-19).

steps.title: SSIS job descriptions from engineering team
steps.desc: Closed 2026-06-18 (Alicia) as not needed: the etl/ inventory (231 objects, docs/etl-data-inventory.md) plus the field-source matrix cover CDP sourcing, so per-job legacy descriptions are off the critical path. AI-inferred interim descriptions captured in the SSIS catalog.

steps.title: Common Client ID coverage map
steps.desc: Done: the CCID audit ran 2026-06-14 (the column is non-functional / all-zero) and the coverage map is complete. CCID is one weighted signal in the deterministic waterfall, not the identity foundation; we build our own CCID from first principles (Option A). The schema/logic ask to Ron was dropped (closed 2026-06-18).
steps.produces: A coverage map of which source systems carry the Common Client ID versus those that will need probabilistic identity matching — input to the Identity Resolution Strategy deliverable.

steps.title: Phase 0 synthesis & stakeholder debrief
steps.desc: Deliver findings, open questions, and recommendations to DAS and Conflict leadership. Close Phase 0, confirm Phase 1 scope.
steps.produces: The Phase 0 closeout — findings, open questions, and recommendations presented to DAS and Conflict leadership, with Phase 1 scope confirmed. The Phase 0 deliverables (Executive Summary, Architecture Plan, Roadmap) are the artifacts this debrief delivers.

steps.title: CDP data model design
steps.desc: Decided: Phase 1 build target is the 15-table model (11 core + 4 AI/ML stubs), locked 2026-06-18 (Alicia + Luis); identity = Option A (deterministic-first, locked 2026-06-17); bitemporal provenance, REST+GraphQL dual surface. Remaining is the DDL build artifact, not a design decision.
steps.produces: The concrete CDP entity schema and ingestion design that Phase 1 build works against, derived from the Phase 0 architecture and roadmap deliverables.

steps.title: Reporting platform decision
steps.desc: Decided 2026-06-14: Apache Superset (self-hosted, headless/embedded, store-neutral) for both customer-facing and internal authoring; Metabase Pro optional add-on. Per-tenant isolation derives from the existing tenanted security model. Closes the Juicebox-replacement evaluation.
steps.produces: A decision on the post-Juicebox reporting platform, informed by the sampled Juicebox reports — drives the reporting migration scope.

steps.title: ETL modernization plan
steps.desc: Decided 2026-06-15 (D-6): Apache Airflow replaces SSIS, ingesting from original sources (not EDW); AWS Glue evaluated and rejected. Two-environment DAG delivery with PR-tested CI/CD. Reimplementing the SSIS logic is execution (the ssis-reimplementation EPIC), driven by the etl/ inventory + discovery, not a 1:1 migration.
steps.produces: A plan for modernizing the ETL layer (Airflow replaces SSIS, Glue rejected, original-sources-not-EDW), grounded in the SSIS deep-dive findings and job catalog.
